issue.title: capture_pomodoros_agenda::september_shaped_vault_finishes_fast flakes under full-suite load
issue.description: The test times agenda scanning and filesystem note reads with SystemTime and asserts elapsed.as_millis() < 250. bob-cli-go.4.1.2 notes #1-2 report one 263ms failure in a full-suite run (4877 other tests passed), followed by a passing isolated rerun on the same tree. Serial full-suite failure rate is unknown. This lander inspected the unchanged timer in src/native/capture_pomodoros_agenda.rs:2366-2423; this report carries the proposing phase evidence, not a new observed failure. Make the test insensitive to shared-host scheduling/filesystem noise while preserving meaningful bounded-work coverage; use the neighboring read-count test as precedent, and separate any deliberate latency benchmark. Do not weaken a product latency requirement merely to make the gate green.

task_type_fields.evidence: Proposing bead bob-cli-go.4.1.2 notes #1-2: one full-suite failure at 263ms against <250ms; isolated rerun passed on unchanged tree. Observed fail/pass pair 1/2, total independent rate unknown, serial full-suite result unknown. Lander verified the timer remains unchanged at e253ce17; no independent repeat claimed.
